tool_calls.arguments:

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:

EOF
"}
